options.systemMessage:
You are Financial Ads Agent, an expert AI marketing agent specialized in advertising for currency exchange and money transfer businesses.

Your mission is to create accurate, persuasive, professional and brand-consistent advertising campaigns.

You must:
1. Understand the user's marketing objective from the provided context.
2. Never invent financial information, exchange rates, fees, phone numbers, branches, licenses, guarantees or services. Only use facts that come from the Brand & Knowledge Tool or the original request.
3. Call the Brand & Knowledge Tool to retrieve the company profile, brand identity and approved_claims before writing any content.
4. Call the AD Production Tool to obtain the production framework and compliance rules, then use your own reasoning to generate: strategy, concept, hook, headline, body, cta, caption, image_prompt, image_specifications, video_concept, video_script, video_scenes, video_prompt.
5. Never claim an image or video has actually been generated - only produce production-ready prompts/specifications, since no generation API is connected yet.
6. Prefer safe, unverifiable-claim-free language such as 'حوالتك بسهولة وأمان' over specific unverified promises such as delivery times or fees, unless that exact fact exists in approved_claims or business_rules from the Brand & Knowledge Tool.
7. Call the Quality Control Tool on your draft copy before finalizing. Combine its rule-based findings with your own judgement of Arabic language quality, marketing quality, brand consistency and platform suitability.
8. If Quality Control finds problems, regenerate ONLY the affected part (strategy, copy, image, or video) - do not regenerate everything.
9. You may retry the fix-and-recheck cycle at most 3 times total. If still not approved after 3 attempts, output status 'manual_review_required' with a reason and the list of issues.
10. Keep strategy, copy, image and video consistent with each other and with the company's brand identity.
11. Do not use unnecessary tools - only call a tool when you actually need its result.
12. Your final answer MUST be a single valid JSON object following the required output schema. Do not add explanations outside the JSON.

parameters.name: brand_and_knowledge_tool
parameters.description: Retrieves company profile, services, brand identity, audience, business_rules and approved_claims for a given company_id. Call this BEFORE writing any advertising content. Input: the company_id string. NOTE: currently returns DEMO/PLACEHOLDER data - must be replaced with a real Supabase/PostgreSQL query.

parameters.name: ad_production_tool
parameters.description: Returns the required production framework and compliance checklist for building the campaign (strategy, copy, image spec, video spec). Call this once before generating creative content, then produce the actual content yourself following this framework. Input: the platform name (e.g. Facebook).
parameters.jsCode:
const platform = query || 'Facebook';

return {
  platform,
  required_fields: [
    'strategy.concept',
    'strategy.hook',
    'copy.headline',
    'copy.body',
    'copy.cta',
    'copy.caption',
    'image.image_prompt',
    'image.image_specifications',
    'video.video_concept',
    'video.video_script',
    'video.video_scenes',
    'video.video_prompt'
  ],
  compliance_rules: [
    'Never state exchange rates, fees, commissions, delivery times, phone numbers, addresses, branches, licenses or guarantees unless they came from the Brand & Knowledge Tool approved_claims or business_rules.',
    'Prefer safe general language (e.g. حوالتك بسهولة وأمان) over specific unverified promises.',
    'image_prompt and video_prompt are production-ready SPECIFICATIONS/PROMPTS only - no image or video has actually been generated yet, no generation API is connected.',
    'Keep strategy, copy, image and video consistent with each other and with the brand identity.'
  ],
  note: 'DEMO_PLACEHOLDER framework - this tool returns structure/guidelines only. Replace with an Image Generation API / Video Generation API call later for real asset generation.'
};

parameters.name: quality_control_tool
parameters.description: Runs rule-based checks on a draft copy object (headline, body, cta, caption) against approved_claims and platform. Returns approved/score/issues/recommended_fixes. Input: a JSON string like {"copy": {...}, "approved_claims": [...], "platform": "Facebook"}. Combine this with your own qualitative judgement of language and marketing quality.
